messages.subject: Shiny Gallery Content Blocked
parts:
I was trying to demo the Shiny Gallery to someone today and it appears there may have been a change where some of the linked pages are not being served via https which causes modern browsers such as chrome to block it.

Mixed Content: The page at 'https://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/kmeans-example.html' was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure resource 'http://gallery.shinyapps.io/050-kmeans-example'. This request has been blocked; the content must be served over HTTPS. 

Can anyone confirm the issue?

Thanks,
-Jeff

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Gallery Content Blocked
